name: search-index-builder
description: Isolated CLI tool that regenerates the root repo's data/search-index.json. Deliberately kept OUT of the root package.json's dependency graph so @huggingface/transformers (and its onnxruntime-node / sharp transitive deps) never affect the deployed app's npm install or npm audit surface. Run via `npm run build:search-index` from the repo root — never wired into any build/deploy step.
